tasks.label: maui-smoke-test-ios-simulators
tasks.detail: Launch-crash gate: installs the Release build on every available iPhone/iPad simulator and launches/force-closes it 3 times, scoring the logs for startup crashes.

tasks.label: maui-smoke-test-ios-simulators-quick
tasks.detail: Launch-crash gate against one iPhone and two iPads per runtime instead of the full matrix.

tasks.label: maui-smoke-test-ios-device
tasks.detail: Launch-crash gate on the paired iPhone using a Release ios-arm64 build (LLVM AOT - the same codegen App Store review runs). Launches and force-closes the app 3 times.

tasks.label: maui-smoke-test-android-emulators
tasks.detail: Launch-crash gate across every Android AVD: installs the Release APK and launches/force-stops the app 3 times, scoring logcat and the app's rolling log.

tasks.label: maui-open-simulator-smoke-results
tasks.detail: Opens the artifacts from the most recent simulator launch-crash gate run.

tasks.label: maui-publish-and-upload-testflight-test
tasks.detail: Bumps ApplicationVersion, builds a signed IPA, and uploads it to App Store Connect via Transporter for the Test environment.

tasks.label: maui-publish-and-upload-testflight
tasks.detail: Bumps ApplicationVersion, builds a signed IPA, and uploads it to App Store Connect via Transporter. Defaults to Production.

tasks.label: maui-publish-and-upload-testflight-production
tasks.detail: Bumps ApplicationVersion, builds a signed IPA, and uploads it to App Store Connect via Transporter for the Production environment.
